semanticDataObjects.label: Opportunities
semanticDataObjects.description: One row per opportunity; represents pipeline, not actual bookings.

semanticDimensions.label: Stage
semanticDimensions.description: Sales stage; Discovery/Proposal/Negotiation are open, Closed Won/Closed Lost are closed.

semanticDimensions.label: Owner
semanticDimensions.description: The account executive who owns this opportunity.

semanticDimensions.label: Close Date
semanticDimensions.description: Date the opportunity closed or is expected to close. Default date for bookings.

semanticDimensions.label: Created Date
semanticDimensions.description: Date the opportunity entered the pipeline. Default date for pipeline generation.

semanticMeasurements.label: Amount
semanticMeasurements.description: Total opportunity value in company currency; for annualized value see ACV.

semanticDataObjects.label: Orders
semanticDataObjects.description: One row per confirmed customer order; represents actual bookings, not pipeline.

semanticDimensions.label: Account
semanticDimensions.description: The customer account that placed the order.

semanticMeasurements.label: Order Amount
semanticMeasurements.description: Total confirmed booking value for this order in company currency.

calculatedMeasurements.label: Win Rate by Value
calculatedMeasurements.expression: SUM(IF [Stage] = 'Closed Won' THEN [Amount] ELSE 0 END) / SUM(IF [Stage] IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') THEN [Amount] ELSE 0 END)
calculatedMeasurements.description: Win rate weighted by deal value, over closed opportunities only. The house default for 'win rate.'

calculatedMeasurements.label: Win Rate by Count
calculatedMeasurements.expression: COUNT(IF [Stage] = 'Closed Won' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(IF [Stage] IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost') THEN 1 END)
calculatedMeasurements.description: Win rate by deal count, over closed opportunities only. Named alternative to the value-weighted default.

semanticMetrics.label: Win Rate by Value
semanticMetrics.description: Governed win-rate metric, by value, closed opportunities only.

semanticMetrics.label: Win Rate by Count
semanticMetrics.description: Governed win-rate metric, by count, closed opportunities only.
